== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Judges are a powerful and highly individualistic group of elite entities within the [[Abidan Court]]. Typically numbering seven, these figures possess immense [[Authority|authority]] and combat potential, often operating independently within their specific areas of expertise. While they are known for being difficult to persuade and fiercely autonomous, they can act in unison to stabilize reality or confront major threats. Their presence alone can reinforce the stability of an [[Iteration]], and they are capable of making decisions that balance the [[Fate|fate]] of countless lives. Individual Judges hold distinct roles and titles, such as [[Makiel]] [[The Hound|the Hound]], who serves as the [[Judge]] of [[Fate]] and possesses exceptional predictive abilities. Other members include [[Judge Suriel|Suriel]] [[The Phoenix|the Phoenix]], who acts as a vital bridge for cooperation between other Judges; Ozriel, the celestial executioner and eighth [[Judge]]; [[Gadrael]] the [[Titan]]; [[Razael]] the [[Wolf]]; [[Zerachiel]] the [[Fox]]; and [[Telariel|Telariel the Spider]]. While they are often viewed as nearly invincible, certain entities like The [[Mad King|the Mad King]] or specialized groups like the [[Silverlords]] pose significant challenges to them. Despite their immense power, Judges can be targeted by specific traps designed to exploit the fact that they can only focus their full strength on one world at a time.}}
